attempts.title: Ash hound and Cinder acolyte directional SVG pilot
attempts.notes: One paid request. Hound four views are useful candidates; acolyte paired headings repeat and remain held. No game-facing contract, selection, animation or user acceptance. Shared cost USD 0.142797 from returned usage. See README for full review.

revisions.label: Original eight-cell SVG · exact API output
revisions.notes: Exact returned UTF-8 SVG bytes, 1536×768. Original output has no image-input reference. Baseline PNG is inspected source context, not sent to the API. Hound row SE/SW/NE/NW; acolyte row SE/SW/NE/NW. Four acolyte cells are held for missing diagonal separation.

revisions.label: Promising hound source candidate · SE
revisions.notes: Extracted named group hound-se, cell [0,0,384,384]. Only outer sheet translation removed; local paths/colors unchanged; standalone 384×384. Actual visible bounds about 27–30×22–24px at 0.1 scale; coherent front/back reading, anatomical refinement still useful.
